extracted.name: Strawberry Streusel Pie
extracted.description: Pie filling was tart. So I added Chinese black vinegar, butter, and brown sugar. Next time I will use fresh strawberries and Chinese black vinegar.
instruction_lines: Chop the walnuts and mix all the Streusel ingredients together. Set aside.
Preheat your oven to 375° Fahrenheit. Mix the butter, vinegar, and pie filling.
Add pie crust to the pie pan. Pour your strawberry mixture in your pie crust. Cover with some of the Streusel. Put into the hot oven for 35-40 minutes. Allow to cool. Serve I hope you enjoy!!!
